question: What is the binding factor for the members of Blind Opera?

options.text: Their love for plays of Tagore

solution:
The correct answer is **'Visual impairment'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage is about a theatre group called the Blind Opera, which is the only theatre group in India as well as Asia, where all the members are blind.
 
• The last paragraph of the given passage describes the advantages of this group as well as the contribution they are making towards betterment of the lives of those who are disabled. 
 
• A line from this paragraph states - '***Coming from diverse backgrounds but bound together by the same disability, they have found an outlet for their creativity through the plays.***'
 
• From this line, we can infer that the binding factor for the members of Blind Opera is the disability they face, i.e., blindness or visual impairment. 
 
• Thus, **option 2 **is the correct answer.
